Class StripeService.StripeTransactionProcessor

public class StripeService.StripeTransactionProcessor
implements Queueable

Queueable class that initiates the processing pipeline for Stripe transactions. Creates database cursors based on either specific transaction IDs or a date range, and chains to LinkStripeTransactionsToPayments job. Supports both immediate processing of new transactions and batch processing of historical unlinked records.
